32198-cleek-of-scotland-yard-detective-s.title: Detective Stories
32198-cleek-of-scotland-yard-detective-s.creator: T. P. Hanshew
32198-cleek-of-scotland-yard-detective-s.description: A book by T. P. Hanshew. Let them take on his job, then, if they thought the thing so easy! Let them have a go at this business of stopping at one's post until two o'clock in the morning trying to patch up the jumbled fragments of a puzzle of this sort, if they regarded it as such child's play--finding an assassin whom nobody had seen and who struck with a method which neither medical science nor legal acumen could trace or name.

48291-strange-stories-of-the-great-valle.title: The Adventures of a Boy Pioneer
48291-strange-stories-of-the-great-valle.creator: Johnston Grosvenor
48291-strange-stories-of-the-great-valle.description: A book by Johnston Grosvenor. "It _is_ pretty water. That's what the Indian name means, O--yi--o, beautiful. A river beautiful," and he hopped about joyously, kicking out another hatchet-shaped stone or two on the stream's edge of one of the choice town lots of the O--hi--o river-port of Marietta in the new farthest northwest State of Ohio, beyond whose small beginnings of civilization lay the wilderness of the great Northwest Territory in this year of 1816.

64313-beneath-the-red-world-s-crust.title: Beneath The Red World S Crust
64313-beneath-the-red-world-s-crust.creator: Unknown
64313-beneath-the-red-world-s-crust.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. ceptibly and his jacket tore and smoldered as he fired. The recoil slide of the heavy automatic thumped a bruise against his ribs, and even as the explosive bullet flared against the window's edge he was on his feet, zigzagging across the street in a stooping rush to flatten himself against the wall.

arxiv-2008-03689.title: Test and Visualization of Covariance Properties for Multivariate Spatio-Temporal Random Fields
arxiv-2008-03689.creator: Huang Huang Ying Sun Marc G. Genton
arxiv-2008-03689.description: Abstract The prevalence of multivariate space-time data collected from monitoring networks and satellites, or generated from numerical models, has brought much attention to multivariate spatio-temporal statistical models, where the covariance function plays a key role in modeling, inference, and prediction. For multivariate space-time data, understanding the spatio-temporal variability, within and across variables, is essential in employing a realistic covariance model.

arxiv-2101-00323.title: TenIPS: Inverse Propensity Sampling for Tensor Completion
arxiv-2101-00323.creator: Chengrun Yang, Lijun Ding, Ziyang Wu, Madeleine Udell
arxiv-2101-00323.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Chengrun Yang, Lijun Ding, Ziyang Wu, Madeleine Udell. Tensors are widely used to represent multiway arrays of data. The recovery of missing entries in a tensor has been extensively studied, generally under the assumption that entries are missing completely at random (MCAR). However, in most practical settings, observations are missing not at random (MNAR): the probability that a given entry is observed (also called the propensity) may depend on other entries in the tensor or even on the value of the missing entry.

arxiv-2205-07888.title: Data-Driven Interpolation for Super-Scarce X-Ray Computed Tomography
arxiv-2205-07888.creator: Emilien Valat, Katayoun Farrahi, and Thomas Blumensath
arxiv-2205-07888.description: Abstract We address the problem of reconstructing X-Ray tomographic images from scarce measurements by interpolating missing acquisitions using a self-supervised approach. To do so, we train shallow neural networks to combine two neighbouring acquisitions into an estimated measurement at an intermediate angle.

arxiv-2207-00652.title: Decoupling estimates in Fourier analysis
arxiv-2207-00652.creator: Larry Guth
arxiv-2207-00652.description: Abstract . Decoupling is a recent development in Fourier analysis, which has applications in harmonic analysis, PDE, and number theory. We survey some applications of decoupling and some of the ideas in the proof. This survey is aimed at a general mathematical audience. It is based on my 2022 ICM talk. 1.

arxiv-2307-08675.title: Exploring Implied Certainty Equivalent Rates in Financial Markets: Empirical Analysis and Application to the Electric Vehicle Industry
arxiv-2307-08675.creator: Yifan He, Svetlozar Rachev
arxiv-2307-08675.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Yifan He, Svetlozar Rachev. In this paper, we mainly study the impact of the implied certainty equivalent rate on investment in financial markets. First, we derived the mathematical expression of the implied certainty equivalent rate by using put-call parity, and then we selected some company stocks and options; we considered the best-performing and worst-performing company stocks and options from the beginning of 2023 to the present for empirical research.

arxiv-2310-17158.title: CosmosDSR - a methodology for automated detection and tracking of orbital debris using the Unscented Kalman Filter Journal: Advances in Space Research
arxiv-2310-17158.creator: Daniel S. Roll, Zeyneb Kurt, Wai Lok Woo
arxiv-2310-17158.description: Abstract The Kessler syndrome refers to the escalating space debris from frequent space activities, threatening future space exploration. Addressing this issue is vital. Several AI models, including Convolutional Neural Networks, Kernel Principal Component Analysis, and Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning have been assessed with various data types.

arxiv-2401-07640.title: Directed Ear Anonymity
arxiv-2401-07640.creator: Marcelo Garlet Milani
arxiv-2401-07640.description: Abstract We define and study a new structural parameter for directed graphs, which we call ear anonymity . Our parameter aims to generalize the useful properties of funnels to larger digraph classes. In particular, funnels are exactly the acyclic digraphs with ear anonymity one.

arxiv-2401-15489.title: Distilling Privileged Multimodal Information for Expression Recognition using Optimal Transport
arxiv-2401-15489.creator: Muhammad Haseeb Aslam , Muhammad Osama Zeeshan, Soufiane Belharbi, Marco Pedersoli, Alessandro Lameiras Koerich, Simon Bacon and Eric Granger LIVIA, Dept. of Systems Engineering, ETS Montreal, Canada Dept. of Health, Kinesiology & \& Applied Physiology, Concordia University, Montreal, Canada muhamma
arxiv-2401-15489.description: Abstract Deep learning models for multimodal expression recognition have reached remarkable performance in controlled laboratory environments because of their ability to learn complementary and redundant semantic information. However, these models struggle in the wild, mainly because of the unavailability and quality of modalities used for training.

arxiv-2402-07311.title: Two-loop non-planar four-point topology with massive internal loop
arxiv-2402-07311.creator: Taushif Ahmed a , Ekta Chaubey b , Mandeep Kaur c and Sara Maggio b
arxiv-2402-07311.description: Abstract We study a set of two-loop non-planar master integrals needed for the NNLO QCD corrections to diphoton and dijet production at hadron colliders. The top-sector topology contains an internal massive fermion loop and is known to contain elliptic curves.

arxiv-2406-00800.title: MagR: Weight Magnitude Reduction for Enhancing Post-Training Quantization
arxiv-2406-00800.creator: Aozhong Zhang Naigang Wang Yanxia Deng Xin Li Zi Yang Penghang Yin
arxiv-2406-00800.description: Abstract In this paper, we present a simple optimization-based preprocessing technique called Weight Mag nitude R eduction (MagR) to improve the performance of post-training quantization. For each linear layer, we adjust the pre-trained floating-point weights by solving a channel-wise ℓ ∞ \ell_{\infty} -regularized optimization problem.

arxiv-2503-19460.title: TrackThinkDashboard: Understanding Student Self-Regulated Learning in Programming Study
arxiv-2503-19460.description: Abstract In programming education, fostering self-regulated learning (SRL) skills is essential for both students and teachers. This paper introduces TrackThinkDashboard , an application designed to visualize the learning workflow by combining web browsing and programming logs in one unified view.

arxiv-2508-19449.title: Stack Trace-Based Crash Deduplication with Transformer Adaptation
arxiv-2508-19449.creator: Md Afif Al Mamun, Gias Uddin, Lan Xia, Longyu Zhang
arxiv-2508-19449.description: Abstract Automated crash reporting systems generate large volumes of duplicate reports, overwhelming issue-tracking systems and increasing developer workload. Traditional stack trace-based deduplication methods—relying on string similarity, rule-based heuristics, or deep learning (DL) models—often fail to capture the contextual and structural relationships within stack traces.

arxiv-2510-16212.title: Born series for s-wave scattering length and some exact results
arxiv-2510-16212.description: Abstract In these notes the Born series for the s s -wave scattering a 0 a_{0} is calculated for a class of central potentials V ⁡ ( r ) V(r) up to sixth order in a dimensionless coupling strength g g . Examples of exponentially decaying potentials as well as truncated potentials involving a single length-scale a a are considered.

arxiv-2511-05095.title: Real-World Adverse Weather Image Restoration via Dual-Level Reinforcement Learning with High-Quality Cold Start
arxiv-2511-05095.creator: Fuyang Liu, Jiaqi Xu, Xiaowei Hu
arxiv-2511-05095.description: Abstract Adverse weather severely impairs real-world visual perception, while existing vision models trained on synthetic data with fixed parameters struggle to generalize to complex degradations. To address this, we first construct HFLS-Weather, a physics-driven, high-fidelity dataset that simulates diverse weather phenomena, and then design a dual-level reinforcement learning framework initialized with HFLS-Weather for cold-start training.

arxiv-2602-07865.title: Orchestrating Attention: Bringing Harmony to the ’Chaos’ of Neurodivergent Learning States
arxiv-2602-07865.creator: Satyam Kumar Navneet, Joydeep Chandra, Yong Zhang
arxiv-2602-07865.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Satyam Kumar Navneet, Joydeep Chandra, Yong Zhang. Adaptive learning systems optimize content delivery based on performance metrics but ignore the dynamic attention fluctuations that characterize neurodivergent learners. We present AttentionGuard, a framework that detects engagement-attention states from privacy-preserving behavioral signals and adapts interface elements accordingly. Our approach models four attention states derived from ADHD phenomenology and implements five novel UI adaptation patterns including bi-directional scaffolding that responds to both understimulation and overstimulation.

arxiv-2603-25187.title: Probing the Lack of Stable Internal Beliefs in LLMs
arxiv-2603-25187.creator: Yifan Luo, Kangping Xu, Yanzhen Lu, Yang Yuan, Andrew Chi-Chih Yao

arxiv-2605-26038.creator: Xinrui Shi, Kai Liu, Ziqing Zhang, Jianze Li, Anqi Li, Yulun Zhang

plos-pone-0004257.title: BOLD Correlates of Trial-by-Trial Reaction Time Variability in Gray and White Matter: A Multi-Study fMRI Analysis
plos-pone-0004257.creator: Tal Yarkoni, Deanna M. Barch, Jeremy R. Gray et al.
plos-pone-0004257.description: PLOS ONE research article. Reaction time (RT) is one of the most widely used measures of performance in experimental psychology, yet relatively few fMRI studies have included trial-by-trial differences in RT as a predictor variable in their analyses. Using a multi-study approach, we investigated whether th

pmc-11401949.title: Designing 2D carbon dot nanoreactors for alcohol oxidation coupled with hydrogen evolution
pmc-11401949.creator: Qitao Chen, Baodong Mao, Yanhong Liu, Yunjie Zhou, Hui Huang, Song Wang, Longhua Li, Wei-Cheng Yan, Weidong Shi, Zhenhui Kang
pmc-11401949.description: The coupled green energy and chemical production by photocatalysis represents a promising sustainable pathway, which poses great challenges for the multifunction integration of catalytic systems. Here we show a promising green photocatalyst design using Cu-ZnIn2S4 nanosheets and carbon dots as building units, which enables the integration of reaction, mass transfer, and separation functions in the nano-space, mimicking a nanoreactor.

pmc-11445725.title: Isolation and Electronic Structures of Lanthanide(II) Bis(trimethylsilyl)phosphide Complexes
pmc-11445725.creator: Jack Baldwin, Adam Brookfield, George F S Whitehead, Louise S Natrajan, Eric J L McInnes, Meagan S Oakley, David P Mills
pmc-11445725.description: While lanthanide (Ln) silylamide chemistry is mature, the corresponding silylphosphide chemistry is underdeveloped, with [Sm{P(SiMe3)2}{μ-P(SiMe3)2}3Sm(THF)3] being the sole example of a structurally authenticated Ln(II) silylphosphide complex. Here, we expand the Ln(II) {P(SiMe3)2} chemistry through the synthesis and characterization of nine complexes.

pmc-11504813.title: Awareness of first aid among adults in Al-Ahsa City, Saudi Arabia: A cross-sectional study
pmc-11504813.creator: Ahmed Alanazy, Abdullah Alruwaili, Hassan H. Al-Hassan, Abdullah Almulhim, Nawaf A. Altaher, Abdulraouf S. Alhomoud, Mohammed Alduhaish, Sultan N. Alanazi, Turki M. Alanazi
pmc-11504813.description: Background:First-aid knowledge among the general public is critical for saving lives in medical emergencies before expert care arrives. However, studies show persistent gaps in layperson first-aid capacity worldwide. This study assessed first-aid knowledge and awareness among adults in Al-Ahsa City, Saudi Arabia, to identify strengths and weaknesses to guide tailored interventions.

pmc-11895799.title: Avoiding Invasive Measures: Sphenopalatine Ganglion Block as a Substitute for Epidural Blood Patch in Post-dural Puncture Headache: A Case Report
pmc-11895799.creator: Saeede Babaiyan, Fatemeh Shakhs Emampour
pmc-11895799.description: IntroductionPost-dural puncture headache (PDPH) is a well-known consequence of neuraxial anesthesia that can impede patient recovery and delay early discharge. Traditional remedies include hydration and the administration of simple analgesics for symptom relief. When symptoms persist despite conservative interventions, an epidural blood patch (EBP) is typically recommended. However, this invasive procedure carries risks and complications.

pmc-12405281.title: Disrupted calcium dynamics and electrophysiological activity in the stratum pyramidale and hippocampal alveus during fear conditioning in the 5xFAD model of Alzheimer’s disease
pmc-12405281.creator: Alexander Erofeev, Egor Vinokurov, Anastasia Bol’shakova, Ilya Bezprozvanny, Olga Vlasova
pmc-12405281.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Alzheimer’s disease (AD) is a neurodegenerative disorder that leads to progressive cognitive decline and significant disruptions in hippocampal neural networks, critically impacting memory and learning. Understanding the neural mechanisms underlying these impairments is essential for developing effective therapies. The 5xFAD mouse model, known for progressive neurodegeneration and cognitive deficits, provides a valuable platform for investigating associative learning and memory impairments related to AD.

pmc-12513814.title: Amiodarone‐Induced Pulmonary Toxicity in an Elderly Patient: A Case Report
pmc-12513814.creator: Bal Krishna Subedi, Naveen Gautam, Anuja Upadhyay, Parikshit Chapagain, Daniel Bitetto
pmc-12513814.description: Amiodarone, a widely utilized and effective class III antiarrhythmic agent, carries a significant risk of severe organ toxicities, notably including the pulmonary system. This report details a case of an 82‐year‐old female who developed amiodarone‐induced pulmonary toxicity (APT) following 2 years of standard 200 mg daily maintenance therapy for atrial fibrillation.

pmc-12653064.title: Perioperative Patient Blood Management in Primary Knee and Hip Arthroplasty—Nonsense or Necessity?
pmc-12653064.creator: Johannes Neugebauer, Clemens Strassegger, David Putzer, Melanie Schindler, Adriana Palacio-Giraldo, Markus Neubauer, Gianpaolo Leone, Herbert Koinig, Dietmar Dammerer, Kevin L Garvin, Panagiotis G Korovessis, Hyonmin Choe
pmc-12653064.description: Simple SummaryThe increase in arthroplasties has led to a focus on PBM. To avoid non-indicated blood transfusions, particularly red blood cell concentrates, this study was performed to determine the prevalence of pre- and postoperative anemia in patients undergoing primary knee and hip replacement surgery.

pmc-12654418.title: Metabolic Signatures of Four Polygonatum Rhizoma Species Mapped Using Untargeted Metabolomics
pmc-12654418.creator: Ning Jia, Jinlan Jiang, Wei Ye, Jiqin Liu
pmc-12654418.description: Background/Objectives: Polygonati rhizoma (PR) is a common traditional Chinese medicine that has been used for 2000 years in China, serving as both food and medicine. It is known for various health benefits, including antidiabetic effects, regulation of gut microbiota, and enhancement of immunity. The most popular PR varieties are Polygonatum kingianum Coll. et Hemsl. (PK), Polygonatum sibiricum Red.

pmc-13090996.title: Utilization of advanced resuscitation skills among doctors and nurses in Uganda
pmc-13090996.creator: Peter Kavuma, Mary Ellen Lyon, Doreen Okong Alaleit, Jonathan Byasi, Janat Tumukunde, Daniel Obua
pmc-13090996.description: IntroductionSudden cardiac arrest remains a major global health challenge, contributing to approximately 3.7 million deaths annually. In Uganda, in-hospital cardiac arrest incidence stands at 2.3%, with only 7.4% achieving return of spontaneous circulation. Since the formal introduction of advanced resuscitation training in 2019, over 840 Ugandan healthcare professionals had been trained.

pmc-13147814.title: Minimally invasive tubular resection of spinal arachnoid webs
pmc-13147814.creator: Florian Volz, Jürgen Beck, Ulrich Hubbe, Amir El Rahal, Christoph Scholz, Marc Hohenhaus, Ralf Watzlawick, Marco Bissolo, Lucas Becker, Marius Schwabenland, Jan-Helge Klingler
pmc-13147814.description: IntroductionSpinal arachnoid webs (SAWs) are rare intradural extramedullary lesions causing progressive myelopathy. For surgical resection, minimally invasive approaches, especially using tubular retractors, remain underreported.Research questionThis study presents a series of minimally invasive SAW resections performed through expandable and non-expandable tubular retractors.

pmc-13420681.title: Acute Aortic Dissection Associated With Cancer Therapy in a Previously Normal Aorta
pmc-13420681.creator: Simon A. Savage, Melissa Moore, Trevor Tnay, Elizabeth D. Paratz
pmc-13420681.description: BackgroundProphylactic management for aortic dissection, a life-threatening emergency, is traditionally guided by aortic diameter.Case SummaryA 60-year-old man, on pembrolizumab and lenvatinib for recurrent clear cell renal cell carcinoma, presented with chest pain, hypotension, and bradycardia during pembrolizumab infusion. Despite previously normal aortic dimensions on sequential imaging, computed tomography aortography revealed Stanford type A dissection requiring urgent surgery.

pmc-13598487.title: A survey of bees (Hymenoptera, Apoidea) in the Bear River Mountains in northern Utah
pmc-13598487.creator: Lindsie M McCabe, Byron G Love, Jonathan B Koch, Skyler Burrows, Kelsey Graham, Diana Cox-Foster
pmc-13598487.description: BackgroundBees provide critical pollination services to a diversity of flowering plants, facilitating the function of terrestrial ecosystems and global food production. Here, we present a checklist of bee species collected in conjunction with a larger systematic study in the Bear River Mountains of northern Utah, United States, over the course of three consecutive summers (2020-2022).

pmc-13634372.creator: Shan Wu, Linlin Xu, Song Su, Yu Zhang, Huishang Wang, Beibei Wang, Yonglian Guan, Hang Xu, Jiajia Mei, Luqu Ma, Deyin Zhao, Juan Zhang, Xishan Xiong
